name: Question 13
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3} & 0 \\ 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,Σ=[\begin{aligned}2\sqrt{2} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,V=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices shown above. Given that $A=UΣ{V}^{T}$ is a singular value decomposition of $A,$  select the correct options in the computations of the matrix $U$ below. From the matrix $Σ,$ we deduce the singular values ${\sigma }_{1}=2\sqrt{2}$ and ${\sigma }_{2}=0.$

Now, we compute the $1$st column of $U.$ It is given by:

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${u}_{1}=\,\,$ |  | $\frac{2}{2\sqrt{2}}$ |  |  |
|  |  | {{field-2}} |  |  |
